What is the smallest thing that actually fits?

This is intentionally anti-upsell. It can tell you to use a free tool, buy a smaller license, or not buy anything. Your answers stay in this browser.

A larger team never gets squeezed into a smaller published license. If no standard tier fits, the result says so.

Rules this router cannot override

  • free may be the final answer
  • price only breaks ties among already-eligible offers; it never justifies a higher rung
  • declared rights/team size are hard license constraints
  • teams above a published max are never routed into a smaller tier
  • the $1,250 Authority Transition Test is never the first purchase; the $250 snapshot is the prerequisite
  • recurring monitoring is not sold while recurring_readiness is ineligible
